components.text:
The Ritual of Speed grants a directional speed boost to players who pass through its range, pushing them onward in the direction the ritual is facing - useful for building fast, fuel-free transit corridors. Tier 0, costs $(blood)1,000 LP$() to activate.
Unlike most rituals, this one is directional - the Ritual Diviner lets you choose which way it faces before building it.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.
